defects.title: Book list goes blank with a script error when the books service returns an error
defects.environment: https://demoqa.com (public demo); Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
steps: Make GET /BookStore/v1/Books return HTTP 500 (the test does this with a network route)
Open https://demoqa.com/books
defects.expected: The page stays usable (navigation and search box visible, no rows) and ideally explains that the books could not be loaded.
defects.actual: The whole page goes blank (#root empty, no navigation, no search box, no message). Uncaught error on every browser, e.g. Chromium "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')". A network failure instead leaves "Loading..." forever with no message.
defects.expectedBasis: Recommendation (R-30: failure behaviour is not specified). A list page should degrade gracefully rather than crash.

evidence.label: Probe 2026-11-11 (500, abort, empty list) on all 3 browsers

defects.nextAction: None. DQB-021 fails while this is open.

defects.title: Register form silently erases what the user typed when the reCAPTCHA token arrives
defects.environment: https://demoqa.com (public demo); Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
steps: Open https://demoqa.com/register
Within about 1 second, type First Name, Last Name, UserName and Password
Wait about 3 seconds without clicking
defects.expected: The typed values stay in the fields.
defects.actual: When the invisible reCAPTCHA v3 token arrives (about 1-3 s after load) all four fields are cleared and any validation errors or "Please verify reCaptcha to register!" message disappear. Clicking Register before the token shows "Please verify reCaptcha to register!" and sends nothing.
defects.expectedBasis: Recommendation: user input must not be discarded without notice.
defects.nextAction: None. Tests wait for the token before typing; no automated check for the erase itself (timing-dependent).

defects.title: Logout does not end the session on the server
defects.environment: https://demoqa.com (public demo); Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
steps: Sign in
Keep a copy of the session cookies (token, userID)
Click Logout
Call GET /Account/v1/User/<userID> with the saved token
defects.expected: After Logout the old token is rejected (401).
defects.actual: Logout sends no request to the server; the old token still returns 200 with the account data. (A later login does revoke it.)
defects.expectedBasis: Recommendation (OWASP Session Management: invalidate the session on logout). Not stated in the requirements.

evidence.label: Probe 2026-11-11 (fi-session.mjs) on 3 browsers; no screenshot (signed-in data)
